description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractHeaderEntryFilter that implements the HeaderEntryFilter interface. It provides a common implementation for filtering header entries with a final apply method and an abstract filterValue method for subclasses to implement custom filtering logic.

classes.name: AbstractHeaderEntryFilter
classes.description: An abstract base class for filtering header entries, implementing common functionality and requiring subclasses to implement the filterValue method.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Final method that applies filtering to a header key-value pair, returning null if the value is null, otherwise calling filterValue.

methods.name: filterValue
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to define specific value filtering logic.
